Package jzelda.levels

Class Level

java.lang.Object
jzelda.levels.Level
public class Level extends Object
Model of a single playable level, including map collision, enemies, pickups, projectiles and completion metadata.

  • Constructor Details

    • Level

      public Level(int id, String name, TileType[][] tiles, List<Enemy> enemies, List<ItemDrop> itemDrops, List<RupeePickup> rupees, double startX, double startY, Rectangle2D.Double exitBounds, boolean requiresKey)
      Creates a level from parsed map data.
      Parameters:
      id - level number
      name - display name
      tiles - tile matrix
      enemies - enemies contained in the level
      itemDrops - item pickups contained in the level
      rupees - rupee pickups contained in the level
      startX - player start x coordinate
      startY - player start y coordinate
      exitBounds - exit collision rectangle
      requiresKey - whether a key is required to complete the level
